snippet.title: Civ Tour: Dai Viet | Civilization VII
snippet.description:
Resist and expand your kingdom as DAI VIET.

Add the Dai Viet civilization to your collection for the Exploration Age in Sid Meier's Civilization® VII!*

► Get Civ 7 today: https://2kgam.es/Civ7
► Link your 2K Account to unlock Napoleon in Civ 7: https://2kgam.es/Napoleon
► Visit the Game Guide for more on each leader and civ: https://2kgam.es/Civ7GameGuide

---------------------------------
HISTORY
---------------------------------
Vietnamese history is a dance of resistance and expansion. The medieval Đại Việt kingdom, especially under the Trần Dynasty, stood against Mongol invasions, even as it expanded southward into Cham lands. This dialectic of resistance and conquest led to the creation of a unique Vietnamese culture, one influenced but not dominated by Chinese sources, and a strong sense of identity.

---------------------------------
ABILITY
---------------------------------
Hịch Tướng Sĩ: When you create a Fortification Constructible, receive a set amount of Culture for every Urban Population in that Settlement (effect scales based on game speed).

---------------------------------
ATTRIBUTES
---------------------------------
- Expansionist
- Cultural

---------------------------------
CIVIC TREES
---------------------------------
Cấm Quân
- Tier 1: Combat Units receive increased Combat Strength during Formal Wars; this effect is increased in your territory.
- Tier 2: Unlocks the 'Cấm Binh' Tradition. Increased Production to Fortification Constructibles.
- Tradition - Cấm Binh: Increased Gold on Fortifications in Settlements with a set number of Garrisoned Units.

Chữ Nôm
- Tier 1: Gain a set number of Relics. Culture Buildings receive increased Culture Adjacency with Tropical tiles.
- Tier 2: Unlocks the 'Con Kênh' Tradition. Increased Culture to all Floodplains tiles.
- Tradition - Con Kênh: Increased Culture to Food Buildings and increased Food to Culture Buildings.

Thành Hoàng
- Tier 1: Unlocks the Water Puppet Theater Unique Improvement and the Thành Huế Wonder.
- Tier 2: Unlocks the 'Ruộng Làng Xã' Tradition. Water Puppet Theater Unique Improvements receive increased Food in Settlements with a Gristmill.
- Tradition - Ruộng Làng Xã: Increased Growth in Towns.

Tứ Dân
- Tier 1: Increased Combat Strength for Units defending in Fortified Districts located on Tropical tiles. Increased Settlement Limit.

---------------------------------
INFRASTRUCTURE
---------------------------------
Water Puppet Theater: Food Base. Increased Happiness if built on Floodplains. Increased Culture for each time this Settlement has received Fertility from a Flood, Storm, or Volcano.  Must be placed adjacent to a River. Improvements, Buildings, and Urban Districts do not get pillaged by Floods in this Settlement.

---------------------------------
CIVILIAN UNIT
---------------------------------
Quận Vương: Unique Settler Unit. When this Unit Settles, receive a set amount of Culture for every Tropical tile within a set distance from the City Center (effect scales based on game speed).

---------------------------------
MILITARY UNIT
---------------------------------
Voi Chiến: Unique Ranged Unit. Can move after attacking. Increased Combat Strength, Movement, Sight, and Production cost compared to the Ranged Units they replace. 

---------------------------------
WONDER
---------------------------------
Thành Huế: Culture Base. Acts as a Fortified District that must be conquered. Cities with a set number of Fortifications receive increased Specialist Limit(resets on Age Transition). Must be built in a City with a set number of Medieval Walls. Thành Huế must be adjacent to a building with Medieval Walls. 

---------------------------------
STARTING BIAS
---------------------------------
- Floodplains
- Tropical

---------------------------------
GAMEPLAY TIP
---------------------------------
Snatch up territory with Floodplains and in the Tropical Biome for the best benefits from your Civics, and build Walls on all your Districts!

*This civilization is now available as a separate purchase (base game required). If you own the Right to Rule Collection DLC bundle or Sid Meier's Civilization VII Founders Edition, then you already own this content.
